verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection/risk-scoring platform whose entire product function is ingesting user event/behavioral data for its clients' businesses — it is not an AI-native developer tool with its own telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out settings for its users. This story misapplies a client-tool privacy-toggle axis to a data-processing B2B platform, so it is a category error rather than a missing feature.
